# Nifi Monitoring Splunk

> Nifi Monitoring Splunk Documentation

Nifi Monitoring is a pair of Splunk apps -- Nifi Monitoring (dashboards) and Nifi Monitoring TA (the add-on that collects the data) -- that centralize the operational visibility of Apache NiFi 1.16-1.28.1 and 2.0-2.11 in Splunk 9.4-10.x. Data arrives by pull (the TA polls NiFi's REST API, recommended) or push (a NiFi flow sends to Splunk's HEC). Developed and maintained, as open source (MIT), by Küdaw (https://www.kudaw.com), a data and AI consultancy and Splunk partner.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://kudawdev.github.io/nifi-monitoring-splunk/index.md): What the apps do and how data reaches Splunk
- [Compatibility and collection strategy](https://kudawdev.github.io/nifi-monitoring-splunk/compatibility/index.md): Supported versions, and choosing pull or push
- [Install NIFI Monitoring](https://kudawdev.github.io/nifi-monitoring-splunk/installation/index.md): Installing both apps
